entities.summary: Kammanu or Malizi was a Luwian-speaking Neo-Hittite state in a plateau to the north of the Taurus Mountains and to the west of Euphrates river in the late 2nd millennium BC, formed from part of Kizzuwatna after the collapse of the Hittite Empire. Its principal city was Melid.
